reviews.text: Wonderful veterinary clinic, so happy that we found this excellent resource. We’ve lived in the in the area for years but had always taken our dogs to a vet that was on the way to our office. When we recently adopted our 5 and a half year old lab we decided to check out the local vets. Dr. Stuart Higginbotham, Dr. Spinks and the support staff including, Chris, Mackenzie and the tech staff have all been great and incredibly helpful. From the laparoscopic spay (yes, amazingly she had not been spayed), to the mass removal on her back, patient and thorough assistance with her “happy tail” issues, separation anxiety. and ear infection. We could not have asked for a better more caring team!
Spinks vet is the only vet I trust. They are amazing and caring and truly looking out for your pets best interest

I started going to Spinx on a neighbor’s recommendation, and I’m so glad I did. Dr. Delaney is incredibly caring, knowledgeable, and thorough.
When we first got our puppy, she had a few health issues, and Dr. Delaney helped her recover quickly. I was especially impressed that the team followed up after appointments and kept us updated on test results.
On top of that, everyone at the clinic is so friendly and welcoming. From the moment you walk through the door, you’re greeted with smiles. I highly recommend Spinx Vet and Dr. Delaney to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care 🥰

Spinks vet clinic is absolutely the best vet clinic I have ever been to over the 30 years that I have had cats!!!

My 16 year old cat Powderpuff got ill recently, and Dr. Higginbotham, along with Dr. Miller, did everything to make her well again.  Dr. Higginbotham is very thoughtful,  thorough, and so kind and caring.  He really takes the time and he really truly cares for the animal, and their owners! I can't thank him and Dr. Miller enough for saving Puff's life, and giving me more time to spend with her during her golden years. Although Puff's condition is progressive, Dr. Higginbotham is awesome, and he is continuing to do everything possible to make her comfortable and happy.  If you want excellent veterinary care, look no further than Spinks.  The best vet you can find, anywhere.  Thank you Spinks for your compassion and support throughout, and ongoing!!! I can't say enough. The staff is also amazing,  and very professional and caring. Thank you everyone 💓

Alfie and I had the privilege of being apart of the Spinks family for 12 years. The entire staff were incredible. Compassionate, timely and friendly care were constant. Dr Spinks and Dr Kleinberg are wonderful people. I could not have asked for a better experience. I lost my best friend recently; although I will not be seeing them soon, I reflect on their care fondly. I highly recommend!!

My cat is on a prescription diet & his regular vet is pretty far from me. Spinks is down the street from my office, so I gave them a call to see if I could purchase his prescription food there. I spoke to Maya on the phone who was extremely friendly and helpful. She said she would need to contact his vet to verify his prescription and that she would get back to me to let me know. She called me back within minutes to confirm she spoke to them and that I could pop by to pick up the food. With such friendly & efficient staff, I have to assume the doctors are amazing as well. Will definitely consider switching to this clinic since it's much closer to home for me!

Absolutely love Dr.Kleinburg! he's provided us thorough health examinations for both our cats and is more than happy to help us understand better the care needed to properly raise our cats to have long happy lives! the staff have been phenomenal! always friendly, helping and incredibly accommodating for us!
Thank you Monruthai!
The best vet clinic.  Dr. Delaney and her whole team are fantastic!! They clearly love animals.  They are very thorough but keep costs in mind.  Very responsive with any questions. Highly recommend.

Our beautiful friend Rambo had a cracked tooth that needed to be removed. The Dr at Spinks Veterinary Clinic did an examination  of our Pup and scheduled a surgery to have it removed. The Dr was very informative and kept us up to speed with the procedure and what to expect during recovery phase. I would recommend this clinic they are professional , friendly & efficient.

They are knowledgeable team and care about your pets. Thank you Spinks Veterinary Team !

We have 2 cats and a dog and we have used there services since we got our dog 5 years ago.
Today we had to put down our Sylvester cat and the kindness we received there today was definitely something to share. Dr. Delaney was beyond compassionate and we were given the time to spend the last couple of hours with our beloved pet!
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving our Vessie such a peaceful and loving send off. We will miss him and we wont forget your kindness and compassion.
Thank you for the review, Ashley!

Mac and his team have been Mol-Dog’s vet for her last 9 years and they were awesome. Mac is very knowledgeable, compassionate, has the pet’s best interests top of mind, and a straight shooter. He was extremely helpful when it was Molly’s time at age 16.5, very sympathetic as we went through that process. He is everything a pet owner wants their vet to be. Definitely recommend him!
Thank you for the review!
Thanks for the positive review, Paula!

BEST VET CLINIC EVER.

I have nothing else to say. They're all the best.

And my dog is a celebrity there, lol.

I cannot say enough about how amazing this clinic is! From the front desk, to the technicians ‘in the back’ they are all the best! I have a challenging lab health wise, and every department of this clinic recognizes this and helps me manage and get what I need to make her life better!
She and I are always a priority!
They understand my needs, totally respect my pups situation and all they want is to help!
Now to the vets…..they are the kindest, smartest, and ‘do anything’ professionals you will find! They go above and beyond 100% to do whatever it takes to help and solve all issues! They are compassionate beyond belief, they love their patients huge and only want the best for them! If your main vet isn’t available, be sure ANY of these guys slip into the role and you continue to be a priority!
If you are fortunate enough to have this clinic in your back pocket to care for your 4 legged family members consider yourself very very lucky!!
Oh, by the way, they are huge Leafs fans, that’s the icing to the cake!!

Spinks Vet is my neighbourhood clinic in midtown Toronto, but its quality is worth traveling for. I have complete confidence in their professional and compassionate staff. The clinic itself is beautiful and modern, but it's the genuine care they show my dog that makes them truly exceptional. I wouldn't go anywhere else.
Thank you Steven! We truly appreciate the great review.
Thank you for the great rating Nancy!

We’ve been taking our cat, Charlie, to Spinks Veterinary since he was about 4 months old, and the care has been excellent. Dr. Delaney Miller has been wonderful with him through check-ups, vaccinations, and his neutering.

Most recently, when Charlie began displaying some unusual behaviour, we had to call the clinic on an emergency Saturday morning. Dr. MacGregor was incredibly helpful and responsive, offering support over the phone and recommending that we take Charlie to an emergency pet hospital. Throughout the following week, Dr. Mac followed up multiple times via email to check on Charlie’s progress, which meant a great deal to us and really speaks to the level of care and dedication from this clinic.

We are so grateful to the entire team at Spinks Veterinary and highly recommend them to anyone looking for kind, knowledgeable, and attentive care for their pets.
Fantastic service for furry friends
Thank you so much for the great review, we truly appreciate it.

We are first time dog parents and brought home a puppy, our goldendoodle in 2022. Dr. Kleinberg has been our vet since then. He has consistently provided the highest level of care throughout our consultations, educating us on preventative care and only recommend necessary medical treatments. Our doggie enjoys her visit at the clinic. The premise is kept clean with spacious reception area and consultation rooms. Free public parking is available at the rear of the building.

All staff members we've met are so nice and compassionate. You can sense that everyone truly cares about your pets as their own.

Thank you for taking care of our doggie and we are grateful to have you as her vet. Love you all Spinks Vet Team!

Brought my 2 year old Boston terrier into Spinks today and it was a great experience. The entire staff were warm, welcoming and knowledgeable. Dr Hodges was amazing with Bella and identified her injury right away. I did some research before choosing to settle down with a vet but I am happy we chose Spinks.

Amazing Vets, and nice people working there.
The Vets here are not pushing to buy stuff or to do procedures we don't want to. We prefer to treat our pets naturally before resorting to pharmaceuticals, and the Vets always gives us the best advice for natural remedies, and what to look out for.

Give 5 ⭐️ because there are no more.
Caring staff and vets
I wouldn't take my dog to any other vet.

Dr. Kleinberg has been taking care of our dogs since we moved to Toronto in 2021. He is incredibly patient, professional, and compassionate. He always provides us with detailed explanations about what to do and why, and he never hesitates to answer even our "dumb" questions, lol.

The entire staff at Spinks is just as amazing—so kind and caring. I truly trust them with our fur babies. Dr. Spinks, Joc, Chris, Maya, and everyone else on the team are all wonderful.

We sadly lost one of our dogs in November 2022. It was a very difficult time—and honestly, it still is—but knowing he was in the hands of such a dedicated and compassionate team brings us comfort. We truly feel we did everything we could to ease his pain and prolong his life in the best way possible.

I'm really grateful we found Spinks.
Unfortunately SPINKS offered no help/solutions with my large sensitive dog - they were unable to vaccinate so I had to change vets.
We had our first appt last week. From the front desk to the Dr. examination and follow up. Professional, accommodating and thorough. Wish we found this clinic sooner.

Was recommended Spinks Clinic by my sister who takes her dog here. Couldn't be happier that we switched. Every single staff we've interacted with is professional, caring, and goes above and beyond.

What I appreciate the most is the level of care and communication every step of the way. We've taken our two cats here multiple times. They are always transparent about treatment plans and costs.

We always leave here feeling like our cats received the best care possible. They've even called and followed up to make sure our sick cat Taco was recovering well.

Dr. Spinks has been our veterinarian for two cats since 2017. He has consistently provided the highest level of service and care throughout our many consultations. Furthermore, he always takes the initiative to keep us in the loop and explain the importance of each procedure.
Recently one of our cats, Abbey, had to have her teeth cleaned and the process was seamless. He followed up with check-up phone calls during and after the procedure to ensure that everything was going as planned.
We highly recommend Spinks Vet Clinic to anyone looking for caring, excellent staff & service.

Thanks again to Dr. Spinks and all the staff at the clinic!

John & Abbey

Our dog has never been to spinks before. I called to ask for some advice after our dog ingested some chocolate. They spent so much time with us on the phone. They provided us with a lot of information and advice. These people care about animals!!!!!! Highly recommend this place. Thanks again
Geoff

There are not enough words to express how amazing this vet clinic. My cat was a patient there for a number of years struggling with chronic illness and the entire team took time and care with her. I never felt like she was just a client and was never pushed into any decisions. This team of vet professionals truly CARE about both the animals and owners.  When she recently came to the end of her life, Dr Miller and Dr Kleinberg made sure to walk us through everything and helped to make the unbearable a little less awful. Thank you to the entire clinic for making sure my cat had the absolute best quality of life she could.

"Chris" from reception is a nightmare.  He is unwilling to assist non customers with selling food and has a terrible approach with customers over the phone.  He lacks the ability to listen and is RUDE!  I needed urinary tract food for my …
The best vet clinic in Toronto. People are amazing and the quality of service is thoughtful and conscientious.

We recently moved to Toronto from Ottawa and reached out to vets in our area since our giant breed dog was limping (and had suffered from various joint issues that had never properly been diagnosed). We really liked the vibe we got from …

I’ve never had a bad experience here with my dog! I can always get an appointment as soon as needed and the staff are all top-tier. Prices are pretty reasonable too. One of my favourite parts about living in the neighbourhood.
Thank you so much Dr. Miller and front desk staff for taking such good care of Earl Grey. We couldn’t have asked for better care in his final year.
